AVIATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.

2. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

5. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.

6. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

7. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.

8. When learning Flight Controls, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Controls.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Controls.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Controls.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Controls.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.

13. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.

14. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Terminal Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ramp services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Airfield Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
